run.name: Synchrony Financial
run.title: CP-OS host session (SYF)
run.summary: Synchrony Financial has a sound fundamental credit profile with identifiable risks. Deposit funding, large liquidity and low credit losses support it; partner concentration and distributions above earnings are the main weaknesses. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

cash.basis: Cash. Same basis; period end 2026-09-30. Letters of credit and drawn amounts on these lines are not printed; the issuer states the capacity as undrawn.

cashflow.basis: Cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Ownership, partner contracts, executed indentures and EBITDA-based leverage are not available, so the view rests on filed financials and summaries.
CP-1 main limitation: The lender reports no EBITDA, so leverage and interest cover in the usual form cannot be produced from the filings.
